Title: n8n: PostgresTrigger Node SQL Injection Allows Authenticated Users to Execute Arbitrary SQL on Connected PostgreSQL Instances
Description:
The Postgres Trigger node interpolated user-supplied identifier parameters (channel, function, and trigger names) into SQL statements without proper escaping, so an authenticated user could inject arbitrary SQL executed against the connected PostgreSQL database with the configured credential's privileges.

Successful exploitation allows full read and write access to the connected PostgreSQL database.
AffectedVersions: All versions before 1.123.67, all versions starting from 2.0.0-rc.0 before 2.31.5, all versions starting from 2.32.0 before 2.32.1
NotImpacted: All versions starting from 1.123.67 before 2.0.0-rc.0, all versions starting from 2.31.5 before 2.32.0, all versions starting from 2.32.1
